_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Align test import path and filename with project conventions.**  
Use the `@/` alias for imports, and rename the file to `.test.tsx` (or `.spec.tsx`) so tooling and conventions are consistent.

<details>
<summary>🔧 Suggested import change</summary>

```diff
-import {
-  formatCurrency,
-  formatCurrencyCompact,
-  getCurrencyConfig,
-} from './currency';
+import {
+  formatCurrency,
+  formatCurrencyCompact,
+  getCurrencyConfig,
+} from '@/lib/currency';
```
</details>

As per coding guidelines `apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}`: Use path alias `@/*` mapping to `./src/*` for all imports.  
Based on learnings `Applies to apps/web/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx} : Write test files with `.test.tsx` or `.spec.tsx` extension using Jest, Vitest, and React Testing Library`.

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  formatCurrency,
  formatCurrencyCompact,
  getCurrencyConfig,
} from '@/lib/currency';
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
In `@apps/web/src/lib/currency.test.ts` around lines 1 - 6, Rename the test file
to use the project's test filename convention (e.g., change
apps/web/src/lib/currency.test.ts to apps/web/src/lib/currency.test.tsx or
.spec.tsx) and update its imports to use the project path alias by replacing
relative import './currency' with '@/lib/currency'; ensure the test continues to
import the same symbols (formatCurrency, formatCurrencyCompact,
getCurrencyConfig) from that aliased path so tooling and linters pick up the
file correctly.
```

</details>
